## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue this addresses.

## Validation

List checks run and relevant metrics or previews. For motion/control changes,
compare physical rollouts and report material differences. Distinguish estimated
observations, prescribed targets and simulated measurements.

- [ ] Relevant issue and acceptance criteria linked
- [ ] Tests and formatting pass
- [ ] Documentation reflects the implemented behavior
- [ ] Stage outputs/failure cases checked, when applicable
- [ ] Physical regression checked, when motion/control changes
